title: Chapter 360 Blood Call
content:
Chapter 360 Blood Call

The moment they saw the city lord's wife, everyone present was shocked and puzzled.

Is the city lord’s wife so powerful now?

What puzzled them was why they wanted to stop them.

Could it be?

Everyone looked at the beam of light coming from the sky again.

At this moment, a familiar figure appeared in the beam of light and slowly moved towards the sky along the beam.

That's, Miss Lu Xue? !

At this moment, everyone's breathing suddenly became rapid, and the fanaticism in their eyes was almost overflowing.

Everything in front of them was telling them a message.

It's the city lord!

At this moment, Lu Xue's face was filled with a happy smile, looking at the sky, feeling very excited.

I finally ushered in this day.

"Xiaoxue."

Lu Xue suddenly turned around and looked down at her mother.

Yan Lingyun smiled slightly, "Say hello to your father for me."

Lu Xue also grinned, "Mom, don't worry, you won't let you wait too long. Our family will be reunited soon."

After saying that, Lu Xue's figure completely dissipated between heaven and earth.

The beam of light that penetrated the sky and the earth began to gradually disappear, but at this time, a figure rushed over in a hurry.

"Wait a minute, wait a minute! And I'm still there, I have a lot of problems!!"

The Master Yuanji kept roaring and roaring above the sky regardless of his face.

But there was no response.

After a long time, Venerable Yuanji sat down on the ground, looking very lonely.

"Sir,"

Several masters of the Order Palace around him looked at his master, feeling a little at a loss.

On the other side, Yan Lingyun looked at Master Yuanji, and her eyes were extremely complicated.

Once upon a time, this person was also the existence she had always looked up to, but now everything seems to have changed.

Yan Lingyun shook her head and slowly left here.

In place, Venerable Yuanji still looked decadent.

But he didn't know that it might be a good thing that he could stay in this world.

If you rely on your own abilities to forge ahead, you will not be much better.

Unless he also has the unsolvable strength as Lu Daosheng.

.........

Chaos Realm.

Everyone was puzzled when they looked at Lu Daosheng's actions.

At this time, the dissipated mark in Lu Daosheng's hand began to emit a faint blood color.

Seeing this scene, the seniors of the human race could not hide their shock even though they had lived for endless years.

This is a technique that the human race does not pass on - blood call!

According to legend, this technique was created by the Human Emperor back then, in order to fear internal strife in the future and give other races an opportunity to take advantage of.

Once the blood summon is activated, all human bloodlines within a certain range can receive the sensing.

That was irresistible, from the intimacy between the bloodlines.

No one will watch their compatriots be slaughtered.

Once the blood is summoned, the human race will inevitably unite.

For a moment, all the humans present felt the boiling blood.

only,,,

Now, they are already the last human lineage in the Chaos Realm. Even if they launch the Blood Summon, no one can come out to help them!

Unless, there are hidden human powerhouses in their Chaos Realm.

But this possibility is really slim.

Everyone looked at Lu Daosheng standing calmly in the void and wanted to say something, but when they reached their mouths, they swallowed it.

This senior must have known this, so there must be a reason for him to do this.

At this time, a strange look gradually appeared on the faces of the other tribes.

Which one is the human powerhouse who came from outside the world playing?

Obviously, there are also strong people in these clans who know the goods. They have already seen that what Lu Daosheng just showed was the technique that the human race did not pass on - Blood Call.

They were surprised, but they were also puzzled.

It is impossible for other human powerhouses to appear in the Chaos Realm.

Otherwise, I was afraid that when they just attacked the human race, the strong people hidden by the human race had already appeared to stop it.

In fact, all creatures in the Chaos Realm think so.

However, Lu Daosheng looked at a certain place in the Chaos Realm with a calm expression, just looking at it.

The next moment, a slight sigh rang in the ears of every creature.

Everyone was stunned and felt that this was a powerful man of the Supreme Heaven!

In the Chaos Realm, anyone who reaches the Supreme Realm can be called the pillar of a clan. If you want to go to a higher level, you can achieve the position of Supreme Heaven.

Even if you look at the entire Chaos Realm, you are one of the best strong men.

The strength of a race depends on how many powerful Heavenly Supreme Ones there are in that race.

The human race today has fallen to the point of being bullied by race because of the last Heavenly Supreme.

Everyone looked into the distance.

As his eyes came, a man with a human appearance appeared in the void.

His face was a little pale, but he still couldn't hide his domineering momentum. His every move was filled with the aura of a strong man.

That's it!

A small number of human race recognized this powerful Heavenly Supreme, with unbelievable eyes.

Because in their impression, this human race supreme had already fallen in the war that year.

But now, he is still alive!

He is a strong man of their human race, and he is also a supreme heaven.

The other human races did not know this human race's supreme, but they could feel the same bloodline as them flowing in each other's body.

That's enough.

Suddenly, a little smile appeared on the faces of the human race.

Unexpectedly, in the Chaos Realm, the strong men of their human race did not all fall.

The other strong men of various races looked fearful and couldn't help but retreat slightly.

Although they are many, the strongest person in the race is just the Supreme Heaven. No one is sure to be able to withstand the anger of a Supreme Heaven.

But at this moment, a strong man whispered: "He has injuries!"

There is injury!

The clans were stunned and then ecstatic.

No wonder the other party didn't show up at the beginning, it turned out to be injured.

Then they won't worry.

If the other party is injured, they are still very confident that they can deal with it together.

But facing the greedy gazes of the tribes, the human race's Supreme Master had no extra face, but just smiled miserably and looked at Lu Daosheng in the void.

Feeling the other party's gaze, although Lu Daosheng's gaze was still very cold, his tone was much more relaxed.

"If you don't dare to show up, I will even clean up you."

Clean up together.

The Supreme Lord of the Human Race did not refute anything, but nodded lightly, and then looked at the alien races that invaded the human race.

At this moment, the alien race was still in anger, just because Lu Daosheng threatened to deal with them together.

It's really arrogance.

call out!

The space was shaken, and a powerful alien race rushed towards Lu Daosheng with the cultivation level of the Supreme Realm.

Although the murderous intent was surging, he had already thought of a way out.

This move is just a test of Lu Daosheng's strength.

Even if you are not in a hurry, you can retreat in time.
